$comment: Which scenario categories each CI lane runs. ONE source of truth: the eval
workflow builds its matrix from this file, and tests/unit/eval/test_ci_lanes.py
asserts every category directory under eval/scenarios/ is either claimed by a
lane or listed in `excluded` with a reason. A category that belongs to no lane
would otherwise just stop being measured, silently, with every lane still green.
NEVER put `vision` or `web_system` in a lane. They read the runner's clipboard,
windows and screen into a scorecard that uploads as a PUBLIC artifact. They are
in `excluded` below and the workflow re-checks that at runtime.
Lanes run on separate ephemeral machines, each with its own Lemonade, so they
are parallel without violating CLAUDE.md's serial rule (which is per-backend).
Rebalance by editing this file; the test keeps coverage honest.

excluded.vision: Reads the runner's screen into a scorecard that uploads as a public artifact.
excluded.web_system: Reads the runner's clipboard, windows and screen into a scorecard that uploads as a public artifact.
